entries.name: AinuIM
entries.note: Ainu katakana composer (AinuComposer, source bifrost.inputmethod.Ainu.Katakana): romaji keys to katakana, small finals ㇰ ㇱ ㇲ ㇳ ㇴ ㇵ ㇷ ㇺ ㇻ, ト゚ and ㇷ゚ for tu and pu, y/w after a vowel as i/u, Latin passthrough, backspace per key. Host tests only; needs a native Ainu check of the small h final and the unassigned small kana (ㇶ ㇸ ㇹ ㇼ ㇽ ㇾ ㇿ), a Midget check, and wiring in kb_input.rs and the kb_layouts source list (the method is in input_methods SOURCES and the plugin engine list).
